A [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the '''son''' of a [[Unidentified Imperial commander (son)|commander]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the son was arrested on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] for an embarrassing indiscretion, the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] hired outside help to bribe the jailers and secure his son's release.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Youthful Indiscretions}}</ref>
